proposed_change: Add adapterVersion and canonicalizationVersion to exported responses
rationale: round trips need explicit migration authority independent of component release

proposed_change: Add isolationAssurance and productionEligibility to runtime requirements
rationale: sandboxed-worker overstates security when Worker or vm only provides cooperative isolation

proposed_change: Separate validation availability into client-public host-protected and human-review
rationale: one final validator label cannot express where authoritative checks can run

proposed_change: Add derivedStatePolicy with forbidden canonical fields and cache lifetime
rationale: layout worker handles and UI state must be disposable and noncanonical

proposed_change: Add capabilityAvailability and unsupported outcome provenance
rationale: offline or deployment profiles may omit a validator without making the response invalid
stable selectors require explicit fallback and failure semantics

proposed_change: Replace accessibility booleans with operation-level alternatives and known limits
rationale: required does not specify how a learner performs the same action without drag or visually

proposed_change: Add measuredPackageProfile with bytes cold-start memory method and environment
rationale: offline grade alone is insufficient for device and deployment decisions
protected tests reviewer notes and probabilistic suggestions have different disclosure rules

proposed_change: Add time memory output and cancellation limits as separate runtime fields
rationale: resource-policy needs enforceable dimensions and diagnostic outcomes
